message.reasoning:
We need to purchase insurance. We need to call purchase_insurance. Need booking_id. But we don't have booking_id because flight reservation failed. We need to first book flight. But earlier we couldn't get flight cost due to no route. Maybe we need to find nearest airport? The user wants flight from San Francisco to Rome. The airports: SFO is San Francisco International Airport. Rome's main airport is FCO (Leonardo da Vinci–Fiumicino). The tool get_flight_cost expects travel_from and travel_to as 3-letter codes. We used SFO and FCO. It returned error: No available route for the given airports. Maybe the system only supports certain airports. We can use get_nearest_airport_by_city to find nearest airport to "San Francisco" and "Rome". But the enum for location includes "San Francisco" and "Rome". So we can get nearest airport codes.
